items.title: Run your server from Exo
items.detail: Server Settings has every page Discord's does, from Access and Onboarding to invites, roles and the Server Guide.

items.title: Group DMs and video calls
items.detail: Start a group DM with up to nine friends, and video call anyone from your DM with them.

items.title: Bookmarks and reminders
items.detail: Save a message for later, or have Exo remind you about it, and find both in your Inbox.

items.title: Message requests
items.detail: DMs from people you don't know wait apart from your chats until you accept them.

items.title: Previews that play
items.detail: YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo, TikTok and SoundCloud links play right in the chat.

items.title: React in one press
items.detail: Your favorite reactions sit on every message, and a custom status shows what you're up to.

items.title: Honest compile times
items.detail: Shaders learns how long each game takes on your PC, and tells ready games apart.

items.title: Snips at once
items.detail: Snip opens instantly and stays light, even across several screens.

items.title: Thanks to snekxs
items.detail: Exo Mouse is built on OpenMouse, made by snekxs, and the Devices room now says so.

items.title: Starts lighter
items.detail: Exo opens sooner and uses about a third less memory: a room you don't open doesn't load.

items.title: Select several games
items.detail: Press Select in your Library to hide, file or uninstall many games at once.

items.title: Arrange your folders
items.detail: Drag a folder to move it, or use Move earlier and Move later on its menu.

items.title: Watch several streams
items.detail: Watch more than one friend's Go Live at a time, each with its own sound.

items.title: Streams that look and sound right
items.detail: Friends' streams show whole and stay sharp, and your stream carries your games and music, never your own voice.

items.title: Glass that stays glass
items.detail: Switching servers, Settings sections and pages keeps the glass clear the whole way.

items.title: The newest Exo Shaders
items.detail: Exo Shaders brings SCSKiller's newest improvements and sets each one up for you.

items.title: Clearer voice
items.detail: Fans, desk knocks and keyboard clicks are taken out of your mic, and your words aren't cut off.

items.title: Everyone at one volume
items.detail: Each person in a call comes through at about the same loudness, so one loud mic doesn't drown out the rest.

items.title: Noise suppression like Discord’s
items.detail: Pick Exo AI, Standard or None in Voice & Video, and Exo tells you when your mic sends nothing.

items.title: Driver updates on Radeon and Intel
items.detail: System keeps your AMD or Intel graphics driver up to date in one click, as it does on a GeForce.

items.title: Clearer glass
items.detail: Menus, sheets and buttons are clear glass now: the colors behind them show through, and their edges catch the light.

items.title: Your PC, checked
items.detail: System shows what's slowing your PC down, gives your PC a power plan tuned for its processor, and keeps your AMD or Intel chipset driver up to date.

items.title: Interrupts in one press
items.detail: System › This PC can move your graphics card, USB and network to MSI mode, so they don't wait on each other. Undo puts them back.

items.title: Exo's profile on Radeon and Intel
items.detail: An AMD Radeon or an Intel Arc gets the same one-press tuning as a GeForce, FSR 4 in FSR 3.1 games on a Radeon, and frame generation for the games you pick.

items.title: Discord stays fast
items.detail: Messages and profiles load instantly, even right after you switch windows.

items.title: Go Live your friends can watch
items.detail: Your stream plays smoothly on Discord's app, in sharper H.265 when everyone watching can play it.

items.title: Watch friends' streams
items.detail: Open a friend's Go Live and watch it right in Exo.

items.title: Lighter on your PC
items.detail: Calls with clips on and the streams you watch take far less of your processor and graphics card.

items.title: Discord, done right
items.detail: Every channel opens, chats open at the newest message, and links show as previews.

items.title: Light, Dark and Void
items.detail: Choose your look in Settings › General. Void is pure black, for OLED screens.

items.title: Gifts in your Library
items.detail: Games friends give you on Steam or Epic show in your Library, ready to accept in one click. Sign in to Steam once in Settings › Game stores.

items.title: Folders you can peek into
items.detail: Hover a folder and its games rise out of it.

items.title: Folders your way
items.detail: Sort each folder its own way, put a game in more than one folder, and give a folder a picture of your own.

items.title: Hide games
items.detail: Right-click a game and choose Hide to keep it out of your Library. Hidden games in the sort menu shows them again.

items.title: Sharper covers
items.detail: Game covers in your Library look as crisp as on the game's own page.

items.title: Fewer shader stutters
items.detail: Compiled shaders are kept on NVIDIA's newest drivers instead of being thrown away.

items.title: More mice
items.detail: Exo Mouse supports 40 more SteelSeries mice and keeps working after your PC sleeps.
